subject: Prod onboarding playbook, gating checklist, and exception routing for Optimize rollout
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Jorge Alvarez <jorge.alvarez@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Jan 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Prod onboarding playbook, gating checklist, and exception routing for Optimize rollout

Team —

As we move Optimize into production for the Acme Health pilot (targeting next Wednesday), I want to align on a single gating checklist and a clear exception routing path. Key asks:

- Marcus: finalize infra SLO signoffs and confirm ab/blue-green cutoff times.
- Karthik: confirm feature-flag strategy and whether we need a capacity reservation on Dedicated for the first 24 hours.
- Monica: prepare an enablement one-pager for CS + support with escalation contacts.
- Jorge / Acme: confirm their audit window and any compliance gating we should expect on day 0.

I've attached a draft readiness checklist (prod-readiness-checklist-v2.xlsx) and an exception matrix with proposed owners. Please reply with updates or edits inline by EOD Monday. If there are unresolved exceptions we should escalate to Leadership by Tuesday 11:00 PT.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cProdChecklist
Jira ticket for rollout tasks: JIRA-OPS-4721

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Program Manager, Product Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: prod-readiness-checklist-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), exception-matrix.csv (csv)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Jorge Alvarez <jorge.alvarez@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Jan 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Prod onboarding playbook, gating checklist, and exception routing for Optimize rollout

Vanessa —

Quick update from infra: SLOs for 99th/50th percentile latency and error rate are green on staging. I'll lock the infra signoff checklist once we complete a warm-up run tomorrow morning (we're scheduling a 8:30 PT perf ramp).

For cutover windows, propose a 02:00–04:00 PT maintenance window for the blue->green swap to minimize user impact. If Acme prefers earlier, we can shift one hour earlier.

On capacity: I recommend a short Dedicated reservation for 24 hours to guarantee capacity during the pilot spike. Cost impact is minimal compared to risk.

I'll attach the warm-up run log after tomorrow's ramp and update the checklist live.

- Marcus
Platform Reliability Lead

Attachment: warmup-run-20270110.log (stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Jorge Alvarez <jorge.alvarez@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Jan 2027 13:38:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Prod onboarding playbook, gating checklist, and exception routing for Optimize rollout

Thanks Vanessa —

Feature-flag plan: we'll roll via a gradual percentage ramp (10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%) over 6 hours, gated on error-rate and latency checks defined in the checklist. The flag will be reversible server-side with an immediate kill switch handled by infra.

Regarding Dedicated capacity: agree with Marcus. I've reserved a burst pool and noted the reservation in the checklist under 'Capacity controls'. If the Acme traffic profile is higher than expected, the fallback path is: 1) route lower-priority customers to fallback model variant, 2) reduce batch size for non-critical routes. Both are in the exception-matrix.csv with assigned owners.

Open question: Do we want the canary to be per-account (only Acme) or global percent? Per-account isolates risk but requires config work on Acme's tenant. If Acme prefers per-account, Monica / Jorge please confirm.

Karthik
Head of Serving Runtime

Quoted previous: "I've attached a draft readiness checklist... please reply with updates or edits inline by EOD Monday."

From: Jorge Alvarez <jorge.alvarez@acmehealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Jan 2027 15:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Prod onboarding playbook, gating checklist, and exception routing for Optimize rollout

Hi all —

Thanks for the plan. A few notes from Acme Ops:

- Compliance: our audit window is 02:00–06:00 PT on Wednesday; we'll expect all telemetry and audit logs to be available to our team within that window. Can you confirm log retention and timeline?
- Per-account canary: we strongly prefer per-account so our QA can validate behavior before global exposure.
- Escalation: please add our on-call (acme-ops@acmehealth.com) to the second-level alerts.

Monica — could your enablement one-pager include the exact on-call numbers and the expected response SLAs? That will help our procurement/sign-off.

Best,
Jorge Alvarez
Director, Cloud Ops — Acme Health
